page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head at the top; page number at top right; no marginal notes beyond a brace in the list.

main_text.p: Itaque, si placet, audiamus recitari ex infinitis aliis nonnulla. Nam universa atque singula qui commemorare velit, scilicet is laborem suscepcrit immensum, scilicet is in hujuscemodi narratione cum opera oleum perdiderit. Prius tamen hoc repeto:

I. Partes,

4. Sanguis, Augiæ: & Caffini: & amplius centum in locis.
Tres saltem guttulæ ex circumcisione, Argentinæ.
Aliæ, de cruce Nicodemi chirotheca exceptæ, Rupellæ Pictonum.
Liquidum, vase crystallino, Bilioni in Auernia.

page.notes: Brace in the list links "Dentes" and "Capilli" to "Charrovii"; the list numbers are partly illegible in the scan. Catchword and signature "Z 2" in the foot line. Some words are faint and uncertain, notably "purpura" and "chirotheca".
